review_notes: The intent asks for trajectories and comparison across panels; four trend units capture the requested analytical operations without splitting individual data points.
Policy periods are not explicitly defined in the table, so units describe changes over available years without causal claims.
Connecticut and Missouri panels have different x ranges (1985-2005 vs 1999-2017), limiting direct same-year cross-panel comparison.
